premises.text: Commercial job sites face unpredictable water, mold, and fire damage without active environmental monitoring
premises.evidence_span: there's currently no active fire monitoring solution for most job sites today

premises.text: A job-site smart sensor network delivers active warning, logistics-usable environmental data, and a lasting build record
premises.evidence_span: First, we do active warning and damage mitigation for those I mentioned before. Two, the data is actually usable for logistics

premises.text: Sensors mount easily on ferrous surfaces, straps, pipes, or 2x4s in dynamic construction environments
premises.evidence_span: It makes it incredibly easy to move in a very dynamic construction environment

premises.text: Deployment follows floor-plan placement with alerts on a dashboard and direct smartphone push notifications
premises.evidence_span: we push notifications directly to the smartphone

premises.text: Priced per square foot with a one-time install fee and monthly fee bundling hardware, firmware, software, and analytics
premises.evidence_span: $0.03 per square foot one-time installation fee, and $0.02 per square foot per month. Everything included

value.text: Real-time environmental monitoring that prevents and mitigates construction-site damage
value.evidence_span: first real-time, end-to-end environmental monitoring solution designed specifically for the job site

secondary_value.text: Buildings carry a lasting quality record of how they were built
secondary_value.evidence_span: Now your building has a Carfax

causal_links.evidence_span: bundling hardware, firmware, software, and data analytics into one easy package
